history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with messy dark hair and wearing a dark gray hooded sweatshirt is looking over his shoulder towards the camera, his hand partially covering his mouth. He is in a dimly lit, concrete parking garage with fluorescent lights overhead. To his left, a white car is parked. In the background, other people are walking away down the aisle of the garage, and more cars are visible. The overall mood is somewhat mysterious and moody, with a focus on the man's gaze. The color palette is dominated by grays, blacks, and muted whites, with cool tones from the artificial lighting. The image has a slightly blurry, candid feel, as if captured in motion.
